field_changes.before: New data center applications; existing approvals (including Meta) exempt unless adding space
field_changes.after: The draft would exempt data-center projects with an approved master development plan, site plan, permit, or current entitlement through an approved site plan or master development plan. An amendment to an existing approved data center would qualify only if it requests no additional data-center space, measured in square feet, beyond the amount previously approved. Facilities used primarily for telecommunications services or emergency communications infrastructure would not be classified as data centers. Whether a particular Meta project qualifies remains unconfirmed.
